customDescription_1: Wish you could combine two pieces? Inspired by a piece that is no longer available? You looked at all ready to ship items and can't find the perfect one? You're yearning to add Petrichor's special touch of magic to your life?
customDescription_2: Don't despair; Petrichor loves to collaborate to create art specifically for their patrons! You'll be able to choose from many precious stones, ethically sourced bones and other focal pieces that are waiting to be brought to life. They can be framed with copper or sterling silver wire.
customDescription_3: {#mailto to=|kate@petrichordreams.com| subject=|Custom piece|}Contact Petrichor to start the discussion{/mailto}. Feel free to include inspirations of past work, style, size, and gemstone or colour.
